verdict.rationale: Virtual displays are a fair question for a remote desktop product, but nothing in the evidence pack documents RustDesk creating a virtual or headless display on the host. The closest item only shows choosing between existing physical monitors, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. The driver-signing discussion never says what the driver is for, so it does not count either.

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless
